SELECT
FROM MSGFILE
AND MSGFILE_CHANNEL = #{args.channel,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
AND MSGFILE_ERRORCODE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.errorCode}, '%'))
AND MSGFILE_FISC LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileFisc}, '%'))
AND MSGFILE_ATM LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileAtm}, '%'))
AND MSGFILE_T24 LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileT24}, '%'))
AND MSGFILE_CREDIT LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileCredit}, '%'))
AND MSGFILE_SEVERITY = #{args.severity,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND MSGFILE_SHORTMSG LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileShortmsg}, '%'))

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT M.* FROM MSGFILE M LEFT JOIN CHANNEL C ON M.MSGFILE_CHANNEL = C.CHANNEL_CHANNELNO
AND M.MSGFILE_CHANNEL = #{args.channel,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
AND M.MSGFILE_ERRORCODE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.errorCode}, '%'))
AND M.MSGFILE_FISC LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileFisc}, '%'))
AND M.MSGFILE_ATM LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileAtm}, '%'))
AND M.MSGFILE_T24 LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileT24}, '%'))
AND M.MSGFILE_CREDIT LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileCredit}, '%'))
AND M.MSGFILE_SEVERITY = #{args.severity,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND M.MSGFILE_SHORTMSG LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{args.msgfileShortmsg}, '%'))
)
